_comment: Module-1 parameters for the identity deployment (Part 2 §3.8, §7). scripts/identity_deploy.py plan reads this file. The identity values (identity_hash, config_policy, config_holder, refs.identity) come from the identity deployment.json, oracle_vkh and refs_token_policy from the operator key, and oracle_active from --mode (oracle: true, jury: false). Every path in `placeholders` must get its confirmed value before a deployment; the plan refuses placeholders unless --allow-placeholders is given.

verdict_policy._comment: PLACEHOLDER: the verdict policy and the Module-1 mode are open items (Part 2 §13.4, owners David and the module owners). The policy applies only to oracle resolutions (OracleResolve, oracle mode): jury resolutions, Inconclusive outcomes and timeouts give no verdict. Both modes embed this policy in AuditingConfig, so it changes the script hashes in both modes. The agent of a verdict is the losing side: auditor_wins names the claimer, claimer_wins names the auditor. action: suspend (duration_ms 1..2592000000) or revoke (duration_ms 0). null means no verdict.

protocol_params._comment: v14 mainnet values from deploy/DEPLOY.md, without oracle_active (--mode sets it). selection_delay, min_agent_age, max_concurrent_cases and min_jury_pool_total are not recorded for v14; these are the params.ak defaults, with min_jury_pool_total = 15 jurors x 25 AP3X. The v14 ProtocolParams record on mainnet holds the same 16 values. Confirm with the module owners.
